summary.intent: Execute Phase 36 (inline upload progress) using the GSD workflow, then clean up the resulting PR through code review, simplification, and multiple rounds of automated review comment resolution.
summary.outcome: Phase 36 fully executed and merged to main — upload store refactored to per-file Map tracking, UploadListItem component created with inline progress UI, old UploadModal/UploadItem deleted. PR 410 shipped after 5 rounds of review fixes, plus a follow-on E2E fix PR 413 and a Phala deploy fix PR 412.

repo: Upload flow is fully sequential: for...of loop in useDropUpload with await on each client.uploadFile(), meaning N files = N sequential encrypt+IPFS pin+FileMetadata IPNS publish+folder IPNS publish cycles
Folder IPNS is published once per file, not once per batch — 5 files = 5 folder metadata pins + 5 folder IPNS publishes, making only the last one meaningful
FilePointer → IPNS name → resolves to → IPFS CID of FileMetadata → contains → IPFS CID of encrypted content (two levels of indirection)
IPNS sync poll interval is 30s; before the onUploadComplete fix, uploaded files only appeared after the next poll cycle
UploadZone had an onUploadComplete prop that was never wired to FileBrowser.handleSync, causing E2E tests to time out waiting for file visibility

The 'cancelled' status was stored in PerFileUpload but cancelFile now deletes the entry instead, making the status type dead — race-condition guards checking status === 'cancelled' needed updating to check for missing entry
envsubst does not support bash default syntax (${VAR:-default}); the :-OWNER fallback in docker-compose.phala.yml was producing broken image references instead of substituting correctly
Zustand v5 does not support a second equality argument on the hook returned by create(); useRef-based equality check is the idiomatic workaround
FileListItem uses a separate .file-list-item-mobile-actions gridcell (hidden on desktop, shown on mobile) — UploadListItem needed the same pattern for mobile action button visibility
Completion timer in UploadListItem only ran while mounted; moved to store-level setTimeout in setFileStatus so auto-removal fires even if the component unmounts during the flash window

code.finding: Refactored from batch-level state to Map<string, PerFileUpload> with per-file actions. Added createUploadId() helper and isActiveUpload() predicate to eliminate duplication. cancelFile() is now atomic (cancel + remove in single set()). setFileComplete removed as redundant with setFileStatus(id, 'complete'). Completion auto-removal timer moved here from component level.
React Rules of Hooks violation — three useCallback hooks were defined after an early return (if (!file) return null). Must be moved before all early returns.
Zustand selector returned a new array every render causing re-render storms on every progress tick. Fixed with useRef-based equality check since Zustand v5 doesn't support second arg on bound hook.

Sequential for...of upload loop. orphanCids tracking was incorrectly including SDK-registered CIDs (which are fully registered and should not be unpinned on partial failure). isUploading derived as boolean in selector to avoid subscribing entire Map.
onUploadComplete prop of UploadZone was never wired; added onUploadComplete={() => { void actions.handleSync().catch(() => {}) }} to trigger immediate IPNS refresh after upload batch completes.

Locators must use '.file-list-item:not(.upload-inline-row)' to exclude upload progress rows from strict-mode matching; extracted to private static readonly ROW_SELECTOR. Without this, getItem() resolves to 2 elements during the completion flash window when both upload row and real file row coexist.

envsubst does not process ${VAR:-default} syntax — the :-OWNER literal was leaking into the image reference causing 'invalid reference format: repository name must be lowercase'. Removed the default, keeping plain ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER} since CI always sets it lowercased before envsubst.

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution: each plan runs in an isolated git worktree branch, merged back to feature branch after completion with conflict resolution on STATE.md
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error from Claude Code is a runtime bug that fires after all tool calls finish — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine actual success
Stale worktrees from prior sessions should be pruned before starting new wave execution to avoid confusion
Verifier catches React hooks violations that TypeScript misses — hooks ordering bugs (after early returns) only surface at runtime
CodeRabbit generates multiple review rounds; expect 4-5 rounds of automated review comments on a non-trivial PR
E2E tests that previously relied on upload rows matching file locators will break after adding upload progress rows — locators need explicit exclusion of in-progress rows
Moving cleanup/side-effect timers from component level to store level makes them resilient to component unmount timing

friction: Multiple git merge conflicts on STATE.md when merging agent worktree branches — required manual resolution each time
Zustand v5 broke the two-argument selector pattern; had to use useRef-based equality instead of the clean equalityFn approach
envsubst silently mangled ${VAR:-default} syntax instead of erroring — caused a Phala deploy failure that was non-obvious to diagnose
E2E tests could not run in isolation (required full auth session from prior steps), making iterative debugging slow
Dev server port collisions (5173 already in use) when trying to start a staging-pointed dev server alongside the local one

The cancelFile atomicity change (delete instead of set-cancelled) broke the race-condition guards in the upload loop — required a second pass to update all guards from status === 'cancelled' to checking for missing Map entry
Wave 1 agent worktree had no stale cleanup built in — had to manually remove leftover cipher-box-wt-phase36 worktree from a previous session
open_items: Phase 37 added: parallel batch upload pipeline — SDK needs new uploadFiles() method that encrypts+pins all files in parallel, then does a single folder metadata update + single folder IPNS publish instead of N sequential updates
The 'cancelled' status type may still be useful for future cancellation states that don't immediately remove the entry (e.g., queued-cancel); left in place for now
EmptyState upload zone does not have onUploadComplete wired to handleSync — only the toolbar UploadZone was fixed
Sequential upload loop means N files = N×(encrypt+IPFS+IPNS) wall-clock time; no parallelism despite per-file progress tracking supporting it visually
Session persistence fails after page reload when running E2E tests against staging locally — pre-existing issue unrelated to upload changes
writable-shares E2E test suite has session loss failures not caused by upload changes — needs investigation
SDK uploadFiles batch publish endpoint already supports arrays but SDK only passes [oneRecord] at a time — batch endpoint could be leveraged immediately without SDK changes
